items.note: Near-drowning despair gives way to hugging the log like a dear friend.
Opens praising the splendid soup, then gives step-by-step recipe instructions.
Blushing and an embarrassed pause give way to easy talk about daily routines.
Formal claims at the start, then casual phrasing like 'sort of settled down, as it were'.
Begins with hunting advice, then drifts into personal asides and hearsay about the lake.
Praises the republic, then warns that the ballot box is becoming an idol.
Struggle in the surf ends with his resolve to dig into the sand and hold on.
Notes Hazlitt's lack of university training, then gives his reasons for accepting it.
Goes room by room with measurements and explains the 'drawing-room' name.
Dumbstruck at first, he then yields hesitantly: 'no doubt you are right'.
Mocks the listener's 'idle precepts' and goes back to finishing her stocking.
Calls work a prayer and a joyful way of showing love.
'Could not believe' it and was 'determined to find out for myself'.
Approves of each sex keeping to its own duties.
Forced cheer (refilling a full cup, loud talk of food, napkin over the photo) to deflect; no open nostalgia or grief.
Easy chat turns into both laughing along to cover the excuse; Anders never reproaches her.
